newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Winbond slashes 1996 sales, profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Winbond slashes 1996 sales, profit outlook.

text.p: Taiwan semiconductor maker Winbond Electronics Corp said on Tuesday it had slashed its 1996 profit forecast by 54.6 percent to T$2.301 billion, the second downward revision in five months.
The company said it also was scaling back its 1996 sales forecast by 24.8 percent to T$12.089 billion, citing slowing sales in the global semiconductor industry.
Winbond, Taiwan's third-biggest semiconductor maker, first cut its 1996 profit and sales projections in April to T$5.068 billion and T$16.09 billion, respectively.
The statement said a price war in semiconductor chips was expected to continue into the fourth quarter.
On the other hand, it said a pact with Japan's Toshiba Corp to develop and manufacture leading-edge semiconductor memory products would help the firm's long-term performance.

Under the December 1995 agreement, Toshiba would provide Winbond with manufacturing technology for 16-megabit dynamic random access memory devices and next-generation one-megabit high-speed static random-access memory devices.
